```{r balancesheet-html, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

tibble(
  Asset = c(
    "Housing & Land", "Housing", "Land",
    "Financial Assets & Fixed Capital of Personal Business",
    "Fixed Capital of Personal Businesses",
    "Cash, Deposits, Bonds & Loans", "Deposits",
    "Stocks, Business Equities & Fund Shares",
    "Pensions & Life Insurance",
    "Offshore Financial Wealth", "Consumer Durables"
  ),
  Value = c(1510, 800, 710, 3518, 26, 684, 350, 1550, 1258, 241, 278),
  Liability = c(
    "Debt", "Debt Secured by a Mortgage", "", "", "", "", "",
    "Net Wealth",
    "Net Wealth incl. Offshore Wealth and Consumer Durable Goods",
    "", ""
  ),
  `Net Worth` = c(695, 400, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 4333, 4852, NA, NA)
) %>%
  mutate(`Net Worth` = if_else(is.na(`Net Worth`), "", as.character(`Net Worth`))) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Wealth Topography: Balance Sheet Example") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("condensed")) %>%
  add_indent(c(2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9))
```
